answer.reason: CoverStatus has three members and the vendor has five values. The adapter maps only REFERRED->in_review and BOUND->bound, and QUOTED, DECLINED and LAPSED have no mapping, so they presumably all fall into 'none'. That makes the core set a coarser cut the adapter translates into, and HireService branches on exactly these three hirer-facing cover outcomes (cover_in_review, no_cover).
